name: Ensemble Girls!
original_name: あんさんぶるガールズ！
source: Kimisaki Academy is a prestigious all-girls school. Though, in the coming academic year, it's planned to become a coeducational academy. The player, a new transfer student, is the first male student to be enrolled. It's his job to help make school life fun and exciting for everyone at Kimisaki Academy.
translation: Kimisaki Academy is a prestigious all-girls school. Though, in the coming academic year, it's planned to become a coeducational academy.
